description: Single source of truth for the declared LXC container ID range on the n02 Proxmox host. Consumed by packages/framework/vos_kernel/utils/topology.py (get_lxc_id_range) and by shell scripts via python3 -c. The full desired state (per-container IPs, VLANs, roles, firewall rules) lives in topology.json at the repo root; this file declares the range/set the debt register refers to.
